_about: Machine-readable part of the bev_fusion problem for the tools in ../autoresearch/tools (paths relative to this folder; decision D23 of 2026-10-31). Launch a training: see records/README.md.
name: camera + radar BEV system (bf)
_experiment_dirs: where the experiment folders (experiment.md = the card) live: the open cards in experiments/, a finished experiment moves to results/experiments/ (D48); the tools look in both (autoresearch/tools/project.py experiment_dirs)
_package: autoresearch/tools/package.py: split_record = the command that writes results/<id>/split.json (the scene lists of the run; cwd = this folder, {run_dir} and {out_dir} relative to it); a package is refused when it fails (D48)
_lower_is_better: for cards written before their "better" map (2026-10-31; evaluation/bev_suite.py writes it since): a card key matches by its last part ('det/dt+0.00/vehicle/all/ate' by 'ate')
_gpu_settle_s: run.py waits while another launcher took its GPU slot less than this many seconds ago: that run has not loaded its data or allocated its memory yet, so the RAM / memory gates would read the box too early (two trainings started in the same second and slowed each other 13 times, 2026-11-04); a training takes about 70 s to its first logged step; 0 = off
_ram_mb: run.py --gpu waits in one first-come-first-served line and starts only when this much RAM is available (3 looks in a row): two trainings run in parallel only if the 24 GB hold both (one with 6 loader workers wants about 10 GB); the box swapped with two trainings and a selftest
_gpu_slots_dir: one GPU on this machine: the slot folder of the lane problem's launcher, so both problems count against the same 2 slots
_trainsuite: python -m trainsuite compose | start (autoresearch/trainsuite/compose.py): presets are json files of overrides, the composed config goes to out, check is the static check of training/startable.py, train is the command run.py wraps

trainsuite._gpu_max_mb: a training starts only when the card has less than this in use (run.py --gpu-max-mb, passed by start / queue add): a t20-sized run holds 8-9 GB of the 12, a second one next to it pages the GPU memory and both ran 13 times slower (2026-11-04); desktop apps hold about 1.3 GB

_runsuite: python -m runsuite check | run | status | queue add (autoresearch/runsuite): the runner of the trained network, jobs of kind run in the same queue as the trainings; {args} is where the mode and the flags go (runner/bev_runner.py documents them)
